scope: Reference source/documentation comparison and targeted measurements of current final KiCad PCB; no circuit modifications.
limitations: Exact revisions ordered by the reviewer are unknown.
Reference compiled circuit JSON downloads timed out; reference DRC/thermal/DFM statements are author-reported, not independently reproduced.
NEMA23 latest README explicitly retains a fabricator DFM hold for 2 oz outer copper versus 0.10 mm tracks.
No physical motor, thermal, power-sequencing or EMI tests were performed.

findings.evidence: Bootstrap positive nets total 8.309–15.451 mm of planar track and 2–4 vias each. U7 sense-input to shunt pad straight distances are 26.038 and 30.901 mm. Gate resistor R43 output is 7.552 mm straight from Q9 gate.
findings.assessment: These are layout-review concerns, not measured failures or manufacturer-specified distance-limit violations.
findings.next_action: Compact the driver/bridges/shunts; shorten bootstrap and gate loops; verify dedicated Kelvin sense branches on both sides of each shunt. Netlist connectivity alone does not establish Kelvin routing.

findings.reference: Both reference designs include TMP102 board-temperature sensing.
findings.current: No separate PCB temperature sensor is present in the fitted IC list; TMC on-chip temperature does not directly measure external MOSFET temperatures.
findings.next_action: Evaluate temperature sensing near the external power stage plus a validated thermal derating/shutdown policy.

findings.reference: Both references power the logic independently from DATA USB.
findings.current: J10 is a self-powered USB device; its VBUS feeds only attach sensing and protection, requiring J1 for startup logic.
findings.assessment: Valid self-powered architecture, but a user-experience difference from the references.
findings.next_action: If matching their single-cable setup behavior, add a protected logic-only DATA supply path with reverse-current isolation and verify all power sequences.

findings.reference: Both references include two INA240 amplifiers for bidirectional winding-current ADC measurements.
findings.current: MCU IIN_MON measures bus input current. R109/R110 serve TMC current regulation; there are no separate phase-current ADC amplifiers.
findings.assessment: A diagnostics feature difference, not proof that current regulation is absent.
findings.next_action: Decide whether measured per-phase current is required; if added, size shunts/amplifiers and ADC filters for this motor and validate PWM rejection.

findings.reference: RP2040 reference uses DRV8825 around 20 V and 1 A peak; NEMA23 uses DRV8452DDWR around 28 V and 2.804 A RMS.
findings.current: TMC5160A external MOSFET architecture targets 48 V / 5.5 A RMS. User previously chose to retain it.
findings.assessment: The reference drivers do not directly meet this target. External MOSFETs are required by TMC5160A, but not the only possible architecture.
findings.candidate: TI DRV8462 in DDV package is rated 65 V operating and 7 A RMS; DDW is only 3.5 A RMS. DDV needs a new footprint/pinout, thermal design/heatsink, firmware and sourcing review; it is not a validated drop-in replacement.

findings.current: All fitted components are top-side, including central AS5047P; industrial interfaces remain on consolidated J7.
findings.next_action: Verify magnet location/gap, shaft access, mounting and heatsink clearance on exact NEMA34 hardware. Preserve user-required industrial interfaces; do not copy reference connector/copper/motor ratings.
